body:
AxoFly is a lightweight, high‑performance fly system for Paper servers (1.21.1+) with full WorldGuard integration. It provides precise control over where players can fly – globally, per region, or with bypass permissions for staff. Perfect for survival servers, citybuild, RPG worlds, or large networks.

✨ Features
/fly command to toggle flight

Automatic flight deactivation when entering restricted regions

Two custom WorldGuard flags for region‑based control:

fly-allow – Allow flying in this region

fly-deny – Deny flying in this region

Bypass permission for staff members

Fully compatible with LuckPerms

Designed for Paper 1.21.1+

Extremely lightweight and efficient

🔐 Permissions
axofly.fly – Allows using /fly

axofly.fly.bypass – Ignores all region restrictions

axofly.admin – Reserved for future admin features

LuckPerms examples:

Code
lp user <Name> permission set axofly.fly true
lp user <Name> permission set axofly.fly.bypass true

WorldGuard Flags

fly-allow – Allows flying in the region

fly-deny – Denies flying in the region

Examples:

Code
/rg flag spawn fly-deny allow
/rg flag farm fly-allow allow

📦 Compatibility
Paper 1.21.1+

WorldGuard 7.0.9+

WorldEdit 7.2.15+

LuckPerms (optional)

🎯 Perfect for
Survival servers

Citybuild

Freebuild

RPG worlds

Network servers

Any server needing precise flight control
